purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Tigania East Form 34B and preserve a genuine source-scan column gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: The official IEBC Form 34B PDF (5 pages) was freshly downloaded and its sha256 confirmed. Pages 2-4 print the polling-station results table, but that table's printed columns stop after REGISTERED VOTERS, ODINGA RAILA, RUTO WILLIAM SAMOEI and WAIHIGA DAVID MWAURE -- confirmed at both 150 DPI and 300 DPI that the table's right border falls at the physical page edge with blank margin beyond it (not a render-pipeline crop). The WAJACKOYAH GEORGE LUCHIRI candidate column, VOTES CAST, REJECTED BALLOTS and TOTAL VALID VOTES columns are absent from every polling-station page. Page 5 (the final page, rendered here at 150 DPI) is a separate summary block reading 'Total number of registered voters: 83,527', 'Total number of voters who turned out to vote: 53,114', 'Percentage of Voter turnout: 63.59%' -- this independently confirms registered_voters, but does not break the turnout figure into total_valid_votes vs rejected_ballots, nor report the Wajackoyah candidate total, so those required fields remain unreadable from this source.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and every page was rendered and read directly (150 DPI for full-page layout, 300 DPI to confirm the right-edge column cutoff on the polling-station table). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Not applicable -- the WAJACKOYAH candidate column and the VOTES CAST / REJECTED BALLOTS / TOTAL VALID VOTES columns are absent from every printed polling-station page of this source PDF, so the four-candidate TOTAL row cannot be read or summed.

note: Registered voters (83,527) is independently source-verified from the page-5 summary box and reconciles exactly to the governed P23 denominator. However, the polling-station results table on pages 2-4 of the official portal PDF is printed with only four data columns (Registered Voters, Odinga Raila, Ruto William Samoei, Waihiga David Mwaure); the Wajackoyah George Luchiri candidate column and the Votes Cast, Rejected Ballots and Total Valid Votes columns are entirely absent from the scan on every page -- confirmed at 300 DPI that the table's right border sits at the physical page edge with blank margin beyond it, ruling out a rendering crop. The page-5 summary box separately reports only a combined 'voters who turned out' figure (53,114, 63.59%) without breaking it into total_valid_votes and rejected_ballots, and does not report the fourth candidate's total. Per the extraction contract, total_valid_votes and rejected_ballots must each be individually source-verified and the four candidate cells must be independently readable to reconcile; neither is possible from this source. Recorded as verification_state=partial_unresolved (registered_voters verified, remaining required fields source_unreadable); no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence.
